workflow: A runtime-wide thread-local resource is being deleted during global shutdown.
A worker concurrently begins attaching to shared execution state and reads the resource before synchronization has blocked it.
Shutdown and attachment access the resource without an ordering guarantee, creating a data race.
Instrumentation detects the concurrent teardown and access, causing the affected operation or test to fail.
summary: Concurrent teardown races with worker attachment to shared runtime state
decision_reason: The bug materially matches the cluster’s workflow of concurrent isolated execution contexts racing on shared process-wide state while one context tears it down and another uses it.
